line: Crowley's account of Atu XVI: the letter Pe, Mars, and the picture of destruction by fire.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: The letter and the planet, and Crowley's description of the picture.

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the letter Pé, which means a mouth; it refers to the planet Mars.
The picture shows the destruction of existing material by fire.

sections.title: Its path on the Tree
sections.line: The text gives no ends for this path. The table gives Key Scale path 27; the general rule is one letter to each path.

quotes.quote: These paths are the paths which join the ten numbers on the
and one letter goes to each path.

sections.title: What the card figures, in his words
sections.line: Crowley's reading of the picture: the cosmic energy shown in its grossest form, and the Eye.

quotes.quote: In its simplest interpretation it refers to the manifestation of cosmic energy in its grossest form.
The dominating feature of this card is the Eye of Horus.
